text: For the director of music. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.
where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.
my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.
my guilt is not hidden from you.
not be disgraced because of me, O Lord, the Lord Almighty; may those who seek you not be put to shame because of me, O God of Israel.
and shame covers my face.
an alien to my own mother’s sons;
and the insults of those who insult you fall on me.
I must endure scorn;
people make sport of me.
and I am the song of the drunkards.
in the time of your favor; in your great love, O God, answer me with your sure salvation.
do not let me sink; deliver me from those who hate me, from the deep waters.
or the depths swallow me up or the pit close its mouth over me.
in your great mercy turn to me.
answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.
redeem me because of my foes.
all my enemies are before you.
and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found none.
and gave me vinegar for my thirst.
may it become retribution and a trap.
and their backs be bent forever.
let your fierce anger overtake them.
let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
and talk about the pain of those you hurt.
do not let them share in your salvation.
and not be listed with the righteous.
may your salvation, O God, protect me.
and glorify him with thanksgiving.
more than a bull with its horns and hoofs.
you who seek God, may your hearts live!
and does not despise his captive people.
the seas and all that move in them,
and rebuild the cities of Judah. Then people will settle there and possess it;
and those who love his name will dwell there.
